newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system via overnight system repurchase agreements on Tuesday, market sources said.
The Fed has a small residual add need before the end of the current maintenance period on Wednesday, sources said.
The Fed could kick off the new two-week maintenance period with a five-day fixed system RP on Thursday and reassess its position after the Memorial Day long weekend, they said.
Analysts still said that a permanent injection of reserves via an outright purchase of bills is possible as early as this week. However, most do not see a bill pass until early next month.
The federal funds rate was trading at 5-5/8 percent in early trade, above its 5-1/2 percent target.
